basis: Read the complete current291-line report, effective task, eight raw current reviews, full audit, all three historical required negatives, production handoff/premises and actual revisions. Independently inspect selected originals and all preserved calculation code/results. The completed English report develops the requested memory/performance/quality constraints, three task pipelines, local/cloud/hybrid trade-offs, cost examples and hardware–model–task matrix. Necessary repairs preserve source conditions, and no remaining necessary content defect was found. Missing actual-device deployment measurements are clearly bounded recommendations, not an unfulfilled demand to run new experiments.

requirements.basis: Four representative phone/PC/edge configurations, private documents, interactive text and frequent speech are developed. Available memory, weights/KV/buffers, architecture, bandwidth/backend, prefill/decode/cold/usable result, sustained power and quality conditions feed worked envelopes and conditional decisions. Network, privacy/retention, fallback, updates, OS restrictions and incremental ownership/integration costs are covered.

evidence.basis: Historical commits, paper versions, measured phases and missing setup details stay attached. Vendor and independent experiments are distinguished from calculations. Own source checks corroborate Qwen cache architecture, S24 performance lock, WhisperTRT warm timing/RSS semantics/truncation, and ML Kit foreground/quota constraints. Complete retained arithmetic supports the tables; other unchanged original checks are reused from the full audit with their explicit boundaries.

adversarial_reasoning.basis: Fits-in-memory does not prove throughput; lower precision has adverse quality/energy examples; Minions saves historical cloud charge while adding workstation time and excluding local cost. Continuous speech requires segmentation and queue/thermal capacity. Excerpts/logs retain disclosure risk and a local failure cannot silently cross an offline boundary. Cost includes correction and fallback rather than token charge alone.

structure_and_depth.basis: Mechanisms drive separate task pipelines, then architecture and cost choices. The full calculation-to-prose mapping preserves units, reservations, phase/extrapolation boundaries, compute duty, accepted-task denominators and ownership models. No isolated table or device catalogue substitutes for the causal explanation.

reader_usefulness.basis: Readers receive concrete bounded inputs/outputs, source-span and transcript behaviors, admission/fallback choices, a hardware fit matrix and six decision rules. Remaining deployment measurements are specific to the proposed use rather than generic caveats.

process_language.basis: Internal producer/review identities, acquisition history and reading-ledger narration are removed. Source versions, cited positions, calculation files and lack of device inference testing remain because they govern interpretation.

natural_expression.basis: Terms are defined before quantitative use and numeric examples lead to engineering decisions. Editorial revisions preserve technical precision and remove internal process wording without reducing analytical depth. No necessary expression defect remains.
